answer: Each identity stands on a ridge and whispers its work to its neighbors - a network that carries news far, ear to ear. The network sends a zephyr, a gentle unpredictable wind, carrying a question only someone who truly did the work can answer. Honest whispers travel far and change as they pass through many different mouths, but a farm's whispers all sound identical - same voice, same words, same path - because one mouth spoke them all. To pass, a farm must whisper a different true story for every sockpuppet, each carried by its own zephyr - as expensive as honest work.
